label: create_q2_case_index_table
sql:
CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE IF NOT EXISTS is459_aml_dev.q2_case_index_dev20220901_m00_v1 (
  dataset_version string,
  run_id string,
  analysis_id string,
  case_id string,
  pattern_type string,
  bundle_uri string,
  participant_count int,
  unique_edge_count int,
  evidence_transaction_count int,
  window_start timestamp,
  window_end timestamp,
  snapshot_cutoff timestamp,
  first_event_time timestamp,
  last_event_time timestamp
)
PARTITIONED BY (window_date date)
STORED AS PARQUET
LOCATION 's3://is459-aml-g2team7-160885259244-us-east-1/gold/cases/dataset_version=ibm-hi-medium-b1b99c68b765580f/run_id=dev-20220901-v2/analysis_id=q2-dev-20220901-m00-v1/case_index/';

label: add_q2_case_index_partition
read_complete_q2_case_index
sql:
-- Run only after the cloud Q2 report passes, using is459-aml-dev (50 MB/query).
-- Read all 15 bounded prototype index rows; compare every field with the frozen
-- local case bundles, including S3 destinations, counts and time boundaries.
SELECT dataset_version, run_id, analysis_id, case_id, pattern_type, bundle_uri,
       participant_count, unique_edge_count, evidence_transaction_count,
       window_start, window_end, snapshot_cutoff, first_event_time, last_event_time,
       window_date
FROM is459_aml_dev.q2_case_index_dev20220901_m00_v1
WHERE window_date = DATE '2022-09-01'
ORDER BY case_id;
